  WHY: This is a diagnostic inaccuracy that can mislead stall investigators; the source rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point as a HARDENING_SUGGESTION, not as a finding.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:99-100, 851-863 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The wait-state close condition treats any non-empty JOBS_JSON as a successful jobs response. On an in_progress poll with non-empty but unreadable JSON, review_waiting_for_runner returns false, yet the branch still logs outcome=started and clears the wait timestamp.
  WHY: A malformed jobs response ends a confirmed runner-wait stretch without evidence that the run got a runner. That underreports the wait duration and can omit the runner-specific ceiling diagnostic; the source rated it NIT.

  WHY: Suggested fix: print the suffix only when `review_waiting_for_runner` returns 0 on this poll, otherwise label it as last seen. Estimated 2-3 lines changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
